Hello,

Thanks for the order number. I have your order Shop···· in front of me, the Bitfortun BS-4 going to (address hidden), paid on October 28.

We wrote to you on October 31 to say the unit had finished final testing and would leave the manufacturer on Monday, November 2. It has not left yet and no tracking number has come through, and I am sorry about that. I do not want to give you another date that I cannot stand behind, so I have asked a colleague to chase the manufacturer directly for the real ship date. They pick this up tomorrow morning and you will get the answer by email in this thread.

The B.4 ships straight from the manufacturer, so the moment it goes out the tracking number is emailed to you automatically, without you having to ask. If our mails have been landing in junk for you, adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will keep that from happening.

Sorry again for the wait.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
